exports.n: Atlas estimate: fine-metal equivalent of every flow of platinum-group metals (HS 7110) in CEPII BACI HS92, 2024, all transport modes: declared value divided by 955 USD per troy ounce, the 2024 average platinum price (World Bank Pink Sheet), i.e. 30.7 million USD per tonne at 31.1034768 g per troy ounce; never above the customs gross weight, which each row's note gives (world: 1,489 t gross weight); values rounded; valued at the platinum price, as palladium, rhodium and the other platinum-group metals have prices of their own that are not in the loaded sources: a flow rich in them is overstated or understated; This ranks customs trade, not mine supply: countries that refine or trade platinum-group metals may rank high through re-exports, and some metal may be declared under another code; the atlas does not measure either.

rows.n: customs gross weight 186.7 t; Customs data record 186 t of platinum-group metals from the United Arab Emirates to India in 2024 (CEPII BACI), 92% of India's recorded imports, against 2.0 t in 2023. They are declared at 9,338 USD per kg, 30% of the 2024 average platinum price (30,712 USD per kg, World Bank Pink Sheet). Gold or another cheaper metal declared as a platinum alloy is a plausible cause; it is not established here; rank 7: the United Arab Emirates is not in the USGS list of platinum-group producers; its exports may be re-exports of metal traded and refined there (a possible reading, not established here)

notes: Trade tables and flows are in fine-metal equivalent, an Atlas estimate: the declared value of each flow (CEPII BACI) divided by the year's average price of the metal (World Bank Pink Sheet), never above the customs gross weight. Customs gross weight counts dore, alloys and the base metal they contain, and some declared quantities are wrong; it is given in the note of each row and in brackets after the world exports figure. Platinum-group metals are valued at the platinum price, the only one of them in the loaded sources.
Production is platinum plus palladium only (USGS gives no rhodium/ruthenium/iridium/osmium by country); the index unit (kg) is shown here in t.

Customs data record 186 t of platinum-group metals from the United Arab Emirates to India in 2024 (CEPII BACI), 92% of India's recorded imports, against 2.0 t in 2023. They are declared at 9,338 USD per kg, 30% of the 2024 average platinum price (30,712 USD per kg, World Bank Pink Sheet). Gold or another cheaper metal declared as a platinum alloy is a plausible cause; it is not established here.
discrepancies: World exports in fine-metal equivalent (Atlas estimate from customs values) 1,200 t (2024) are 3.3x USGS world mine production 363 t (2025): customs trade can count refined or recycled metal, and metal re-exported from one country to another, more than once, so it is not comparable with mine output (the atlas does not measure how much); USGS is used for production, BACI for trade.
